target_customer: Construction contractors and project teams that plan weekly work
problem: Construction teams planned work informally and could not easily share look-ahead plans or track and remove constraints.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for construction teams (presumed)

founders.name: Vinayak Nagpal
founders.background_notes: Named as co-founder only by Dealroom; not on the YC page.

exit.reason: No announcement or post mortem found; the domain is now a parking page.

competitors.name: Touchplan
competitors.what: Cloud planning software for the Last Planner System covering pull planning, look-ahead planning and weekly work plans

technical_complexity.rationale: A web planning and task tracking tool is ordinary application engineering.

defensibility.rationale: General project tools such as Asana and construction suites could cover the same workflow, and no data or network effect is documented.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not documented. The company went inactive and its domain lapsed to a parking page.

market_need_then: The YC description frames pain in weekly planning and constraint removal on construction projects; no spend or survey data was found.

branding.domain_note: vernox.io is now a Namecheap parking page, so the original domain has lapsed.

identity.voice_and_tone: The YC tagline starts with Like Asana or, positioning it as a simple team tool

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community material about the brand was found, and later unrelated companies use the same name.

outcome_analysis: Vernox was a two person YC Summer 2015 company building production planning software for construction and took a reported 120,000 dollar seed from YC. It is listed inactive and its domain is parked, but no source gives a date or cause, so the cause is not public and failure factors stay empty.
notes: The seed rests on two databases that disagree slightly (CB Insights 120K dated 2015-08-20, Dealroom 125K or 120K dated 2015-08-05); no outlet article. The Touchplan blog URL could not be opened (403), so its October 2015 date is taken from the URL and a search listing, and it is a weak competitor source. The Asana reference comes from a YC tagline as summarized, not a competitor study. Loot-drop describes Vernox as an on-demand labor startup, which conflicts with all other sources and was discarded.
